name: skillsophy
description: Practical philosophical reasoning lenses, a task-based selector, and a council for comparing disagreement.

interface.longDescription: Select and apply ten philosophical reasoning lenses to real work. Clarify assumptions, test claims, examine duties and consequences, and compare disagreements through a council. Initial release; effectiveness is under evaluation.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me choose a philosophical reasoning lens for the task I am working on.
